spots.title: Point drop-off
spots.why: The bottom falls away fast off this point; fish rest deep and move up the slope to feed.

walleye.name: Walleye
walleye.bait: jig and minnow or crankbait along the edge

perch.name: Yellow perch
perch.bait: small jig or minnow near bottom

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.bait: cut bait on the bottom, deep holes
